answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide strategy and the research associate does not hold a central office for it.
The budget planning round involves office holders of higher rank and leadership.
Appointment committees deal with professorships and higher ranking roles.
The faculty council is led by the dean and handles faculty affairs without general inclusion of research associates.
The study commission prepares degree programmes and teaching matters where research associates are not members.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters.
The research associate works on a doctorate and assists in research, but is not designated for the internal research funding round.
Module revision involves degree programme descriptions.
Laboratory equipment procurement is for teaching laboratories.
Orientation week planning is for new students.
